user_decision.label: Source-attached completion blockers and completion-slot eligibility-withdrawal status

binding.add_blocker: source-attached immediately below the stable Breakdown Add field/control row
binding.title_blocker: source-attached inside the existing DP-VQ04 Scratch-title editor status region after editor-state copy
binding.withdrawal: one persistent non-blocking status in the vacated Breakdown completion slot after overlay, complete Context, and Reopen are removed
prohibited: automatic Add, Save, Cancel, or Archive
theme-ID product behavior or copy branch

add_blocker.trigger: persisted Archive eligibility is otherwise true and the mounted-page Add draft is non-empty
add_blocker.copy: Add this idea or clear the draft to complete this Scratch.
add_blocker.placement: inside the Add region immediately below the stable field/control row; DP-VQ05 operation copy stays first when both status families exist
add_blocker.actions: no new completion action; retain existing Add and ordinary text-editing paths
add_blocker.effect: suppress completion presentation without changing persisted eligibility, draft, Add control, or reliability state
add_blocker.focus: retain Add-input or current user-owned focus and associate the status to the Add input
add_blocker.lifetime: persist without a timer while the otherwise-eligible non-empty draft remains current; never announce each keystroke

title_blocker.trigger: persisted Archive eligibility is otherwise true and Task 137 reports open, dirty, saving, conflicted, or reconciling

copy.open_or_dirty: Save or cancel the Scratch title edit to complete this Scratch.
copy.saving: Saving the Scratch title before completion…
copy.conflicted: Resolve the Scratch title conflict to complete this Scratch.
copy.reconciling: Checking the Scratch title before completion…

title_blocker.placement: after the current editor-state sentence inside the same persistent associated status region
title_blocker.actions: retain the complete DP-VQ04 action hierarchy for the current editor state; add no completion action
title_blocker.effect: preserve editor, draft, comparison or recovery content, locks, and persisted eligibility
title_blocker.focus: retain DP-VQ04 logical field/action focus through appearance, state changes, remote updates, and removal
title_blocker.lifetime: persist only while the matching synchronous snapshot and otherwise-eligible Scratch remain current

eligibility_withdrawal.trigger: the mounted page previously presented overlay, complete Context, or Reopen and persisted eligibility becomes false because active Breakdown rows and/or staged candidates exist

copy.active_breakdown_only: Completion is no longer available because a Breakdown item is active.
copy.staging_only: Completion is no longer available because an item is in Staging.
copy.both: Completion is no longer available because Breakdown and Staging have active items.

eligibility_withdrawal.ordering: remove scrim/card, complete Context, and Reopen first; reveal current work; then render the actual aggregate cause in the vacated completion slot
eligibility_withdrawal.inactive_scratch: archived, deleted, or inactive selected Scratch exits through the canonical workspace owner and renders no withdrawal status
eligibility_withdrawal.actions: no Close, Dismiss, Retry, Reopen, Archive, or hidden action
eligibility_withdrawal.focus: local source action retains canonical focus; remote cause never steals focus; if a removed Archive, Cancel, or Reopen control owned focus, move it to the surviving Breakdown heading
eligibility_withdrawal.lifetime: persist for the same selected active Scratch while its current aggregate cause remains; do not reconstruct across Scratch switch, route exit, reload, or unmount

recovery.blocker_resolution: remove only the source blocker and let Task 159 recompute from current truth
recovery.eligibility_restoration: remove withdrawal immediately and let Task 159 own overlay, complete, Reopen, and readiness announcement
recovery.forbidden: no separate restoration rail, timer, dismissal, Retry, persistence, waiting stale control, or archive from a previous completion snapshot

accessibility_and_motion.status: visible static non-color mark plus exact sentence; polite atomic announcement once per new or changed cause, never per rerender
accessibility_and_motion.ordinary_motion: immediate and static blocker, withdrawal, removal, and focus changes
accessibility_and_motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, actions, focus, and lifetime
accessibility_and_motion.prohibited_motion: fade, slide, scale, blur transition, skeleton, shimmer, spinner, progress loop, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation

theme_mapping.griddo: technical ruled source status and compact ruled completion-slot notice with static warning mark
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: same-paper source annotation and pinned filing-status note
theme_mapping.neumorphism: inset source/completion troughs using existing depth variables without a second raised card
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving source ribbon and stable completion ribbon without bounce
theme_mapping.origami: seam-bound source note and folded completion notice without animated fold
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven [completion blocked] and [completion withdrawn] records with exact copy and no blink or glow loop
theme_mapping.retro-mac: hard 1-bit in-window source line and in-section completion system status
theme_mapping.graphite: restrained editorial source caption and strengthened-rule completion notice

implementation_boundary.excludes: product implementation in Task 118, completion predicate changes, Task 137 or Task 159 headless changes, Archive transaction changes, VQ-12, Task 119 start, Task 160 start, adjacent fallback, and theme-ID logic

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 118 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased; Task 119 remains unstarted and Task 160 is not started by this receipt
